description: The delivery fee, distance and estimated delivery time from one venue to an address or a saved location, with no cart: a quick way to compare venues before building an order. The figure is the same one a draft order then shows. Also says whether the address is inside the venue's delivery area and whether the venue is open now. Needs a connected WaitApp account.

deliveryAddress.description: Full delivery address. Not needed when savedLocationId is given

savedLocationId.description: The id of one of the person's saved locations (list_saved_locations)
